1.description: Highly stylized loot filter with multiple filter level tiers for customizable strictness, colorful  and intuitive symbols for runes, gems, maps, charms, etc. Check the Author's Page for examples.

2.description: Same as Erazure — Main but unidentified unique and set items show as their identified names when dropped.

3.description: Same as Erazure — Main but with a twist: high runes and super rare drops hide their identity on the ground when dropped, showing as BIG GG until you pick them up.

4.description: Same as Erazure — Main but with Path of Exile sound effects on valuable drops. Polished visuals and tiered, customizable filter levels enhanced with PoE-style sound notifications.

5.description: Same as Erazure — Main — PoE but unidentified unique and set items show as their identified names when dropped.

6.description: The mystery of BIG GG drops combined with Path of Exile sound notifications.
